card.name: Citation and dictionary-entry punctuation
card.fires_on: Digits, periods and slashes inside reference citations (journal, year, page or ID numbers) and right after a medical term's syllable-split headword in a dictionary entry.

modes.label: Citation numbers and dots
modes.description: A digit or period within a journal reference, such as a page number, edition number, or journal abbreviation.
modes.example: Community Dentistry Oral Epidemiology 2005; 33: 39<<7>>–9 - Blackwell Munksg

modes.label: Dictionary headword slash
modes.description: The slash that opens the pronunciation after a syllable-divided medical term.

card.plain: It marks the fine print of reference lists and dictionary entries, such as page numbers and pronunciation guides.
